title: Task
description: Frontmatter schema for tasks/<task-id>.md. The Markdown body of the file is the description. Authoritative on conflict with SPEC.md. Unknown fields are allowed and must be preserved when writing.

formatVersion.description: Version of the file format. Optional for reading (absent means 1), always written by the tool. Readers must refuse versions they do not know.

id.description: UUID4. Identical to the file name (without .md). Stays stable over the task's lifetime, even after title edits.

title.description: Editable (updatedAt is updated). The file name does NOT change.

imagePath.description: Relative to the project folder, e.g. 'images/<task-id>.png'. Null until an image is set, and null again after it is removed. Extension is one of png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp (see SPEC.md, Task image).

dueDate.description: Optional. Calendar date 'YYYY-MM-DD' by which the task should be done, no time and no time zone. Absent or null means no due date.

status.description: Label per type in the presentation layer (e.g. todo->Done, question->Answered). The data model only knows open/closed. No delete: this is the only completion mechanism.

createdBy.description: Actor who created the task (free text, e.g. user name or 'claude'). Immutable.

updatedBy.description: Actor of the last content change; set together with updatedAt.

labels.description: Free labels. Order as assigned, no duplicates, empty allowed. Stored as written; comparisons ignore case (see SPEC.md, Comparing labels).

updatedAt.description: UTC, ISO 8601 with Z. Updated on every content change (edit, close/reopen, image, comment). Central field for the tool's 'silent since' purpose.

comments.description: Append-only, no delete, no edits. Chronological by createdAt.
